turns.user: If Daniel breaks his hip in an accident, what does the Simple Fracture benefit pay, what condition applies to it, and is it separate from the death benefits?
turns.visible:
If the Simple Fracture benefit applies to Daniel's case “Hip”, the conditional illustration is S$3,750: 75% of the Simple Fracture benefit limit of S$5,000, under the Group Insurance Product Summary; it is an illustration from the document's terms, not a payment or an insurer's decision.
The wording says the benefit applies when bodily injury results from an accident and causes a listed Simple Fracture; the hip row is 75% of the limit.
Contact Aldermoor Life Ltd (through the employer or scheme administrator, for this group scheme) about the Scheme X Group Insurance - Certificate to ask what it needs for a claim.

Section 5 - Compassionate Death Allowance Benefit
If an Insured Person dies as a result of an Accident, we will pay the funeral expenses incurred, up to $2,000,
on receipt of proof of death and the relevant documents in our prescribed form.
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or the Voluntary Scheme.

(% of Sum Insured)
Neck, Skull or Spine (Full Break)	100%
Hip	75%
Jaw, Pelvis, Leg, Ankle or Knee (Other Fracture)	50%
Cheekbone, Shoulder or Hairline Fracture of Skull or Spine	30%
Arm, Elbow, Wrist or Ribs (Other Fracture)	20%
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or Voluntary Scheme.

If an Insured Person:
(i)	disappears as a result of the sinking or wrecking of the ship, aeroplane or vehicle in which he was travelling at the time of the Accident; and
